title: Mixed Event — Play That Beautiful Sound! — Episode4 The Boy and the Trumpet

meta.Episode: Episode4 — The Boy and the Trumpet
meta.Event Outline: Having surpassed RAD WEEKEND, life has been quiet for Toya. Just when he feels like trying something new, the owner of an instrument store who he owes a lot to asks him to deal with customers at an event!

rows.Line: Shibuya Instrument Day

rows.Speaker: Announcement
rows.Line:
<That concludes this concert.
Please watch your step and make sure to take all of your belongings with you.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Phew...
That was a nice concert.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I wasn't expecting to see ten different groups perform... The bands that played only Japanese instruments or traditional instruments from around the world gave me a chance to hear plenty of music that I normally wouldn't.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: You seem to be really enjoying things, Kanade.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh, I can't help it...
It's just been so long since I got to listen to a live performance.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: What did you think, Mafuyu?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I thought it was good.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I'm glad this is turning into a nice distraction for her.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Anyway, what should we do now?
The instrument booths and such all still seem to be open.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Whoa!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Are you okay, Kanade?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Y-Yes.
But I bumped into something just now.

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line:
Oh...
I-I'm sorry...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I-I'm also sorry.
I should've paid more attention to where I was going...

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: N-No, it was my fault for...

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: *Wince*

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(Is something wrong?
He looks like he's about to cry.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
A-Are you okay?
Did you get hurt somewhere when we bumped into each other just now?

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line:
N-No, I'm not hurt.
I'm sorry... It's just...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Huh? Wh-What's wrong?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Umm...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(H-He's gone silent...
But we can't just leave him here like this.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: F-For now, why don't we go take a seat over on that bench?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Good idea.
That should give you a chance to settle down.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: H-How does that sound?

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: Thank you very much.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
You're welcome.
Anyway, shall we?
se_walk_women_002_1
se_walk_women_002_2

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line:
I'm really sorry...
I didn't mean to cause you two so much trouble.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: No, that's okay.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
But you still haven't told us what's wrong.
Did you get lost?

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line:
N-No, I'm not lost!
It's just...

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: It's just...

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: I'm so frustrated...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Frustrated?

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: So, I'm in a marching band. I play the trumpet...

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: But I'm always having trouble, and making weird sounds. Because of that, I end up getting left out of performances...

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: Then, I saw all those people during today's concert sound really cool while playing their trumpets...

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line:
I got so jealous...
And frustrated. I started wondering why I'm so bad and they're so good...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: Why am I so bad?

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: I really want to learn how to play beautiful music like them...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (“Like them”...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I sort of understand how he feels.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I also wanted to learn to play like Dad.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I wish I could do something to help this boy...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (But I don't know how to play the trumpet. What do I do in this situation?)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Come to think of it, the booth for wind instruments seems to have a demo area.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: The people there may be able to teach you how to produce the sound you want.

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh, that's right.
That booth does seem to have teachers or instructors available for help.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
So, are you free right now?
Unless you need to leave soon...

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line:
No, actually...
We have free time to look around until the end of the convention.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Really?
Then, why don't you try visiting that demo area?

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: B-But I still probably won't be able to play very well... I've already tried doing so many different things...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, that may be true.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: However, if you keep trying, then I'm sure you'll eventually figure out a way.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: You don't have to if you really don't want to, but I think you should give this a chance.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: If you don't feel comfortable going all by yourself, then we'll join you.

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line:
Thank you very much.
I'll give it a try!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Good!
Then, shall we?

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: Let's go!!
